```{r}
#| message: false
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(wesanderson)
```

File paths: 

```{r}
fp_cee = "~/../../Volumes/subseasonal_extreme/"
fp_res_test = "weekly_ave_test/Results/weekly_model_results_2021-2024/"
fp_rf = "RF/RF_Final_Code/outputs/"
fp_res_test_eesn = 
  "ML-methods-for-weather-forecasting-internal-dev/EESNs/results/"
```

# Data Preparation

Load and starting cleaning of random forest data:

```{r}
#| warning: false
rf_fi_temp <-
  read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee,
    fp_res_test,
    fp_rf, 
    "feature_importance/RF_final_top3_grouped_PFI_standard.csv"
  )) |>
  rename_all(.funs = tolower) |> 
  rename(
    target_region = region,
    importance = mean_importance
  ) |>
  mutate(feature = str_remove(feature, "weekave_")) |>
  separate(
    feature,
    into = c("var1", "var2", "var3", "var4", "var5"),
    remove = FALSE
  ) |>
  rename(climate_var = var1) |>
  mutate(
    climate_var = ifelse(
      var2 %in% c("500", "850"), 
      paste0(climate_var, var2), 
      climate_var
  )) |>
  mutate(
    var2 = ifelse(
      var2 %in% c("500", "850"), 
      NA, 
      var2
  )) |> 
  rename(region = var2) |>
  mutate(
    var6 = ifelse(
      str_detect(var3, "pc"),
      var3, 
      ifelse(
        str_detect(var3, "mean"), 
        var3, 
        NA
      )
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    var3 = ifelse(
      str_detect(var3, "pc"),
      NA, 
      ifelse(
        str_detect(var3, "mean"), 
        NA, 
        var3
      )
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    region = ifelse(
      is.na(var3),
      region, 
      ifelse(
        is.na(region),
        var3, 
        paste0(region, "_", var3) 
      )
  )) |>
  select(-var3) |>
  mutate(
    var7 = ifelse(
      str_detect(var4, "pc"),
      var4, 
      ifelse(
        str_detect(var4, "mean"), 
        var4, 
        NA
      )
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    var4 = ifelse(
      str_detect(var4, "pc"),
      NA, 
      ifelse(
        str_detect(var4, "mean"), 
        NA, 
        var4
      )
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    region = ifelse(
      is.na(var4),
      region,  
      ifelse(
        is.na(region),
        var4, 
        paste0(region, "_", var4) 
      )
  )) |>
  select(-var4) |>
  rename(stat = var5) |>
  mutate(
    stat = ifelse(
      is.na(stat) & is.na(var6), 
      var7,
      ifelse(
        is.na(stat) & is.na(var7),
        var6, 
        stat
      )
  )) |>
  select(-var6, -var7)
```

More cleaning of random forest data:

```{r}
rf_fi_temp2 <- 
  rf_fi_temp |>
  mutate(
    region = ifelse(is.na(region), "temp", region),
    stat = ifelse(is.na(stat), "temp", stat),
    climate_var = ifelse(
      climate_var %in% c("MW", "NE", "SW", "W"), 
      "current_week",
      climate_var
    ),
    climate_var = toupper(climate_var),
    climate_var = str_replace(climate_var, "CURRENT_WEEK", "Current Week"),
    climate_var = factor(
      climate_var,
      levels = c("Current Week", "H500", "H850", "SLP", "T500", "T850", "TS")
    ),
    importance = round(importance, 2),
    region = fct_recode(
      region, 
      "AR" = "arctic",
      "NA" = "atlantic_ocean",
      "TA" = "atlantic_trop",
      "US" = "conus",
      "target" = "current_week",
      "EA" = "east_asia",
      "MC" = "mexico_gulf",
      "NP" = "pacific_ocean",
      "TP" = "pacific_trop",
      "CA" = "southern_canada"
    )
  ) |>
  select(target_region, horizon, group, climate_var, region, stat, importance)
```

Compute ranks associated with random forest FI: 

```{r}
rf_fi_ranks <-
  rf_fi_temp2 |> 
  select(target_region, horizon, group, importance) |> 
  distinct() |>
  arrange(target_region, horizon, desc(importance)) |>
  mutate(rank = 1:n(), .by = c(target_region, horizon))
```

Complete cleaning of random forest data:

```{r}
rf_fi <-
  rf_fi_temp2 |>
  left_join(rf_fi_ranks, by = join_by(target_region, horizon, group, importance)) |>
  mutate(facet = paste0("Group: ", rank, "\n Importance: ", importance)) |>
  summarise(
    stat = paste(unique(stat), collapse = "\n"),
    .by = -stat
  )
```

Load and clean ESN data:

```{r}
esn_fi_raw = read.csv("../EESNs/results/gpfi-final-nreps30.csv") 

esn_fi <-
  esn_fi_raw |>
  filter(rep == "fi_rep1") |>
  filter(rank <= 3) |>
  select(region, tau, group, climate_var, input_region, stat, fi_ave, rank) |>
  mutate(facet = paste0("Group: ", rank, "\n Importance: ", round(fi_ave, 3))) |>
  mutate(climate_var = fct_recode(
    climate_var, 
    "SLP" = "slp", 
    "T500" = "t500", 
    "H850" = "h850"
  )) |>
  mutate(climate_var = factor(climate_var, levels = unique(rf_fi$climate_var))) |>
  mutate(input_region = fct_recode(
    input_region, 
    "MC" = "mexico_gulf",
    "NP" = "pacific_ocean",
    "AR" = "arctic",
    "TP" = "pacific_trop",
    "CA" = "southern_canada",
    "TA" = "atlantic_trop",
    "NA" = "atlantic_ocean",
    "US" = "conus",
    "EA" = "east_asia"   
  )) |>
  rename(target_region = region) |>
  rename(region = input_region, horizon = tau, importance = fi_ave)
```

# Color Preparation and Legends

Attach colors to regions:

```{r}
regions = sort(as.character(unique(c(rf_fi$region, esn_fi$region))))
region_colors <-
  wesanderson::wes_palette(
    name = "Zissou1",
    n = length(regions),
    type = "continuous"
  )

regions_and_colors = data.frame(region = sort(regions), color = region_colors)
```

Attach colors to the data frames:

```{r}
rf_fi_with_colors <-
  rf_fi |> 
  left_join(regions_and_colors, by = join_by(region)) |>
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = sort(regions)))

esn_fi_with_colors <-
  esn_fi |> 
  left_join(regions_and_colors, by = join_by(region)) |>
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = sort(regions)))
```

Pull colors specific to model:

```{r}
rf_colors <-
  rf_fi_with_colors |>
  select(region, color) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(region)

esn_colors <-
  esn_fi_with_colors |>
  select(region, color) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(region)
```

Prepare legends:

```{r}
rf_legend_plot <- 
  rf_fi |>
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = rf_colors$region)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = climate_var, y = region, fill = region)) + 
  geom_tile() + 
  geom_text(aes(label = stat)) + 
  facet_grid(horizon + facet ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top", drop = FALSE) + 
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = rf_colors$color) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) + 
  labs(fill = "Region")

esn_legend_plot <-
  esn_fi |>
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = esn_colors$region)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = climate_var, y = region, fill = region)) + 
  geom_tile() + 
  geom_text(aes(label = stat)) + 
  facet_grid(horizon + facet ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top", drop = FALSE) + 
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = esn_colors$color) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) + 
  labs(fill = "Region")
```

Extract legends:

```{r}
rf_legend = rf_legend_plot |> cowplot::get_legend()
esn_legend = esn_legend_plot |> cowplot::get_legend()
```

# Plots

## Functions

```{r}
create_fi_plot <- function(data, reg, hor, cols) {
  data |>
    filter(horizon == hor, target_region == reg) |>
    mutate(region = factor(region, levels = regions_and_colors$region)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = climate_var, y = region, fill = region)) + 
    geom_tile() + 
    geom_text(aes(label = stat)) + 
    facet_grid(facet ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", drop = FALSE) + 
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right") + 
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = cols |> 
        filter(horizon == hor, target_region == reg) |> 
        distinct(region, color) |> 
        arrange(region) |>
        pull(color)
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    ) + 
    labs(
      title = paste0("Lead-Time: ", hor, "-week")
    )
}
```

```{r}
join_fi_plots <- function(plot1, plot2, plot3, plot4, legend, reg) {
  
  plot_no_legend <- 
    plot_grid(
      plot1,
      plot2,
      plot3,
      plot4,
      nrow = 2,
      ncol = 2
    )

  plot_with_legend <-
    plot_grid(
      plot_no_legend, 
      legend, 
      rel_widths = c(3, .2)
    )
  
  title <- 
    ggdraw() + 
    draw_label(
      paste0("Region: ", reg),
      x = 0,
      hjust = 0
    ) +
    theme(
      # Align title with the left edge of the first plot
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 7)
    )
  
  plot_grid(title, plot_with_legend, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.05, 1))
  
}
```

# All ESN FI Results

```{r}
esn_fi_top3 <-
  esn_fi_raw |> 
  filter(rep == "fi_rep1", rank <= 3) |>
  rename(horizon = tau) |>
  select(region, horizon, groups, rank, climate_var, input_region, stat, groupvars) |>
  distinct()
```

```{r}
esn_rmses <-
  read.csv("../EESNs/results/final-rmses-chosen-by-all-data.csv") |>
  filter(data == "testing") |>
  rename(horizon = tau) |>
  select(target_region, horizon, rmse) |>
  rename(region = target_region)
```

```{r}
esn_fi_top3_df <-
  esn_fi_top3 |> 
  select(region, horizon, groups, rank, groupvars) |>
  mutate(groupvars = str_replace_all(groupvars, "\n", " ")) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(rank = paste0("Group ", rank)) |>
  left_join(esn_rmses, by = join_by(region, horizon)) |>
  select(region, horizon, rmse, groups, rank, groupvars) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = rank, values_from = groupvars) |>
  mutate(rmse = round(rmse, 3)) |>
  rename(
    Region = region,
    Horizon = horizon,
    RMSE = rmse,
    `Total Groups` = groups
  )
```

```{r}
esn_fi_top3_df |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
esn_fi_top3_df |> 
  xtable::xtable() |> 
  print(include.rownames = FALSE)
```
